title: WhoVotedThis
description: A simple application that allows conducting polls anonymously. Written in TypeScript using React and Material UI. **Completed within 48 hours** during PeddieHacks 2021 and won the Qoom Web App Challenge.

title: Search Engine
description: A small C++ file-search application that loads files in a folder and allows searching by title or content with a set of useful operations.

title: Student Management System
description: A small application that replicates a university’s database of students, lecturers, and staffs. It uses C++ to develop a simple CLI and execute operations on CSV files.

title: Codeforces Round #558
description: I was one of the problem setters of Codeforces Round #558, as a writer of 2 problems (A and C) and tester of 3 problems (A, B, and C).

title: RunTesT
description: An extensive C++ tool for generating test cases for competitive programming problems. It runs the solution's implementation automatically for each generated test case and returns pairs of input and expected output.

title: Codeforces Round #482
description: I was the leading problem setter of Codeforces Round #482, as a writer of 2 problems (A and B) and tester of all problems.

title: themisv2
description:
A minimal Windows-only automatic scoring tool for competitive programming problems.

This project was inspired by [Themis](https://dsapblog.wordpress.com/2013/12/24/themis/) — an automatic scoring application for Vietnamese competitive programming contests — and [testlib](https://github.com/MikeMirzayanov/testlib), a C++ library that helps with generating test cases and writing checkers for Codeforces problems.
